text.offer: Paddock says, "You want to know a secret? Every drunk mage in this bar has told me the same one. Just outside the city, past the western border of the Twisted Wood, there's a cave. Deep, dark, spooky, and icky. And somewhere inside it, a mana node. Nobody comes back from it smelling nice, but they all come back stronger."
text.progress: Leave Tos by the main gate, go to the western border of the Twisted Wood, and find the Deep, Dark, Spooky, Icky Cave. The node is somewhere inside.
text.complete: That's the smell, all right. And the look of someone with a bit more magic in them.

steps.objective: Bond with the node in the icky cave
